policy: The Android app of the current release and of the three releases published before it. docs/ANDROID_COMPATIBILITY.md explains the fields; scripts/android-support-window.mts checks them.

emulators.why: reported crash on a Pixel with Android 17 (0.21.3)

releases.note: From this app the bridge is level 3 (appLock). The earlier apps in the window have no native app lock: the page offers them the UniHub PIN, and their contacts sync (which sends X-Background-Sync: 1, like every app's own requests) reads any 403 other than MODULE_DISABLED as a refused change and skips the contact. So the server must keep the contacts routes open to the background sync while a device falls short of a required app lock, and the page must keep the PIN for apps below bridge level 3.

From this app the download manager starts only from download tickets and the public app update (/downloads/unihub.apk), without the session cookie; it follows redirects by itself, so neither endpoint may redirect. The earlier apps in the window add the cookie to the same ticket URLs. So the server must answer a ticket the same with or without a Cookie header, whether the cookie's session is live or has ended, and keep the app update public.

handshake.note: Every shell in the window checks that GET /api/version answers app = "unihub". Shells from 0.22.1 also read features: they offer notifications only while they list android-notifications. Shells from 0.23.0 also read protocol and minApp when connecting: they refuse a protocol other than 1 and a minApp above their own version. So the server must keep app = "unihub", keep listing android-notifications while a shell in the window uses it, keep protocol 1 while a 0.23.0 shell is in the window, and must not raise minApp above the oldest shell here.
